reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests the car perform a new behavior—pulling forward—so the requested action overrides the reference’s static showroom pose.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the actual anchored frame’s live-action rendering; no restyling or medium change was authorized.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested for the car, so its observed carbon-fibre body is retained from the reference.
reasons.lighting: The requested action specifies emerging “out of the dark,” an explicit visible lighting/darkness condition rather than mere mood or location, so lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint, or camera movement is requested; the actual frame’s framing is retained.
reasons.palette: There is no explicit color grade or tonal-contrast instruction; darkness is treated as lighting rather than a requested palette regrade, so palette remains reference-governed.
